title: Exploring the property space of periodic cellular structures based on crystal networks
summary: Catalog of periodic strut networks from RCSR and EPINET, homogenized with an Euler-Bernoulli FE beam model at rho_rel ~0.01; analyses stretch/bending dominance via E/Es ~ rho^n and average connectivity Za.
relevance_to_project: Likely source of our dataset (names with Z and RCSR symbols, E/Es=C rho^n, n=1 or 2). Paper reports 17,087 entries vs 17,262 in our catalog: the ETH Research Collection catalog may be a different version; the 41 very-small-member entries probably relate to the 40 excluded entries but this is not confirmed. SI (not read) holds C/n details.
